_doc: The 'find us' map (components/map-embed.php). PRIVACY: nothing is requested from the map provider until the visitor presses the poster, so no third-party cookie is set for anyone who never asks for the map. 'embed_url' is the provider's iframe URL; 'link_url' is the normal page the anchor falls back to when JavaScript is off.
title: Where the counter is
sub: Two minutes from the station, on the market side of the road.
poster_alt: Street map of the area around the counter
note: Nearest parking is on the far side of the market square.
